RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairPla.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairPlane_idempotent
RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairPla.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (u v : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
    RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq v = 1 →
      RectangleCLT.faceDot u v ^ 2 < 1 →
        RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairPlane u v * RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairPlane u v =
          RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairPlane u v

RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_pair_f.expanded_type:
∀ {p : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (f g : RectangleCLT.Face p),

RectangleCLTArxivV1.selectorWeight_le_su.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.selectorWeight_le_supplementalHPairReference
RectangleCLTArxivV1.selectorWeight_le_su.expanded_type:
∀ {p K : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (α : Fin (K + 2) → RectangleCLT.Face p),
  α 0 ≠ α 1 →
    ∀ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector p),
      RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α x ≤ RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairReference s (α 0) (α 1) x

RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_pair_s.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_pair_selector_projected_reduction
RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_pair_s.expanded_type:
∀ {p r K : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (v : RectangleCLT.Vector p) (σ : ℝ)
  (α : Fin (K + 2) → RectangleCLT.Face p),
  (∀ (j : Fin p), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (A j) = 1) →
    RectangleCLT.faceDot (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0))
            (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 1)) ^
          2 <
        1 →
      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
          (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightedScore (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id fun g =>
            RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α ((σ • A).mulVec g + v)) ≤
        2 *
              RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorProjection s (σ • A) v α
                (RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairPlane (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0))
                  (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 1))) +
            4 *
              (RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorMass s (σ • A) v α *
                Real.log
                  ((∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                      RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairReference s (α 0) (α 1)
                        ((σ • A).mulVec g + v) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) /
                    RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorMass s (σ • A) v α)) -
          RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorRadialTrace s (σ • A) v α

passages.claim: The actual orthogonal projection onto the two original unit normals is symmetric/idempotent, retains both original coordinates, and has the exact two-coordinate norm-square formula.
passages.method_variation: Uses the original first normal and its explicitly normalized orthogonal complement, rather than a bisector/difference frame; the projected plane is the same.

passages.method_variation: Domination uses the full original denominator and proves that the entire remaining probability product is at most one.
